$comment: ANG-015 (#385) U10 gate-scope decision — the single machine-readable source of truth for the Angular parity gate's run scope and baseline comparison. Consumed by packages/frontend-angular/playwright.config.ts (run scope) and parity/compare-baseline.mjs (baseline comparison). Editing this file changes what the parity gate runs and accepts — every change is a disposition-register event (parity/disposition-register.md) and must be deliberate, never a way to make a red gate green. File paths are relative to packages/frontend/ (the test root).

anchorRedClasses.$comment: Every file carrying anchor-red (failed/timedOut) rows must appear in exactly one class; counts are the anchor-recorded red-row totals across all 3 browser projects (see disposition-register.md §6).

A.meaning: Residual Node-URL inline API (hardcoded http://localhost:3000 setup calls -> ECONNREFUSED -> downstream 401s)

B.meaning: Non-fixture identities (spec signs in as admin2/manager/user-independent identities the Java fixture world does not create -> real sign-in 401 -> loginAs timeout)

C.meaning: Node-era contract expectations (specs wait for Node-era response shapes/flows; the frozen Java contract answers differently)

D.meaning: Real-time / socket.io rows (React socket.io-client vs Java raw WS /ws, ADR-026 — transport-incompatible until R1 evidence, AD-2)

E.meaning: Debug/utility + mixed-era assertions (assertion-light debug specs, mixed mock/real UI-detail expectations, in-spec conditional skips)

unanchoredKnownFiles.$comment: Files that run inside the gate scope but have NO anchor coverage in the ae42c67 React-on-Java baseline. e2e-promotion files are surfaced in every parity run and are non-gating until a baseline capture anchors them (a red row here is a register/anchor event — disposition-register.md §7 — never a silent pass and never widened into expected-red without evidence). angular-native-tier0 specs are the merged port issues' own Angular evidence (ANG-006..013); their expected status is GREEN — a red row is a live Angular regression and gates (route to the owning issue).
